fields.title: 📖 Muḥākamah: Dispute is brought back to Qurʾān and Sunnah
fields.body:
🖋️ **Ibn Kathīr** said:

> ***“Ibn Kathīr explained that the referral in dispute is to the Book of Allah and to the Sunnah of His Messenger ﷺ.”***

🌙 **Conclusion:** The standard in dispute is not tribal feeling, party, custom, or the spirit of the age. The standard is revelation.

immutable.source: 📝 Ibn Kathīr, Tafsīr al-Qurʾān al-ʿAẓīm, Tafsīr zu Sūrah an-Nisāʾ 4:59.
